status_vocabulary: covered = the cited tests establish the criterion through production routes; partial = some aspect lacked a test or observation; missing = no test or route established it. Every cited test was observed passing on the current pin (host-run release store executables for ignored cases; dev shell for non-ignored cases); see focused-observation.json and host-run-observation.json.

summary.observation_gap: None for the cited tests. The flake-app invocation itself is recorded separately in host-run-observation.json.

criteria.criterion: The real selected evaluator constructs the example and the production import/runtime paths execute it.
criteria.notes: Before: execution used Executor::run_authorized directly. Added `lattice authority inspect` + `lattice run` with an exact grant and the headless saved-workflow route.

criteria.criterion: Two instances receive independent identities; nested and cross-instance connections resolve correctly.
criteria.notes: Identities and edge targets were only implied by per-role outputs; now asserted directly.

criteria.criterion: Reusing a handle adds no extra operation instance.
criteria.notes: Six operations with four edges from one shared output port.

criteria.criterion: Fanout/join obey the selected target's value-sharing/discard rules.
criteria.notes: Before: only the permissive positive. Now non-copyable string and non-droppable exitcode registries reject in elaboration and admission.

criteria.criterion: An independently authored reference agrees on ordered boundary values and required dependencies, without demanding incidental event-order or numeric-ID equality.
criteria.notes: Dependencies were compared by count only; now by admitted instance role.

criteria.criterion: Run one supported local operation profile with exact fixture authority; no external service is required.
criteria.notes: Local shell profile (shell-source/shell-stdin) under an OperatorRunContextSource grant.

criteria.criterion: The same effectful graph without required authority fails before adapter execution or credential delivery.
criteria.notes: Before: the denial used an edited fork, not the same graph. Added the same admitted graph with none, foreign and exact grants.

criteria.criterion: A barrier/event-controlled zero-data sequence proves the second effect cannot start before its prerequisite.
criteria.notes: Defined before this change; observed passing in the host run.

criteria.criterion: Unknown runtime binding, wrong types, invalid expression dependency, collision, wrong-scope handle, cycle, and expansion overflow reject before dispatch.
criteria.notes: Overflow was only tested at projection admission; added library generation cap and native node/instance expansion limits with a fitting control.

criteria.criterion: Configuration expressions, effects, and implementation references remain attached to the intended instances after remapping.
criteria.notes: Per-node effect slot, implementation and command now asserted against the admitted origin role.

criteria.criterion: Independently changing an import, parameter, contract default, evaluator, selector, same-named registry implementation, elaborator, or final graph invalidates the affected binding.
criteria.notes: Added parameter, imported member, evaluator-source and elaborator drift.

criteria.criterion: A same-output control retains distinct provenance when source/evaluator inputs differ.
criteria.notes: Source difference; one selected worker cannot produce a distinct-evaluator same-output pair.

criteria.criterion: Existing materialized workflow import/export and named-child semantics remain compatible.
criteria.notes: test_workflow_format 26 passed, test_subworkflow_execution 5 passed on the current pin.

criteria.criterion: Cancellation, budgets, result validation, and effect checks continue through existing production routes.
criteria.notes: Only effect checks were tested before. Snapshot cancellation, required shell success and orchestration round budgets now run a constructed sequence.

criteria.criterion: Retain source, expanded graph, exact command/results, and negative controls in the supported Nix qualification workflow.
criteria.notes: The sandboxed construction-runtime check could never pass (sandbox store entries are not root-owned) and retained only logs. Replaced by the host-run app; see host-run-observation.json.

criteria.criterion: Import/store/reopen a program with a helper function, selected module, two instances, and generated collection while preserving source/parameter identities.
criteria.notes: Selected member via `--member` is in the CLI case.

criteria.criterion: Author-source export preserves the captured structure; expanded export is separately identified.
criteria.notes: Requires the captured worker; runs in the host app.

criteria.criterion: Existing workflows with no source association continue to work without fabricated provenance.
Selecting a generated node shows its template/instance and a valid location where mapping is available.
criteria.notes: Instance was never asserted and `lattice authoring origin` was untested; both added, with port and unavailable controls.

criteria.criterion: Parameter edits compile/readmit a new revision with topology/configuration differences inspectable before execution.
A graph edit without an unambiguous supported source correspondence requires materialized editing or remains unapplied; it cannot silently rewrite arbitrary source.
Editing a template affects its instances after recompilation; changing one instance parameter affects only that instance as defined by the source.
Source/import/library/parameter/registry/evaluator drift invalidates the appropriate compilation association.
criteria.notes: Parameter and imported-member drift added.

criteria.criterion: Stale authoring drafts cannot overwrite newer revisions.
Evaluation or admission failure retains the last admitted workflow and the editable failed draft with bounded diagnostics.
Preview, compilation, navigation, and export neither start workloads nor deliver credentials.
criteria.notes: Before: only flat source. Added an effectful constructed graph through preview, admission, origin, exports and inspection.

criteria.criterion: In-flight execution continues against its exact admitted snapshot.
criteria.notes: Before: only old clones were rerun after readmission. Added a run blocked on its first effect while a newer source revision is admitted; observed passing in the host run.

criteria.criterion: Existing exact-preview/activation checks and materialized round trips remain valid.
Tests distinguish source identity, graph identity, execution identity, and semantic equivalence.
